description: This Java interface defines configuration settings for activity checks within a persistence context, including methods to retrieve intervals for inactive and deleted entities, as well as an enum specifying default configuration values with associated paths.

classes.name: ActivityCheckConfig
classes.description: An interface providing configuration for entity activity checking, including methods for retrieving inactivity and deletion intervals, and an embedded enum for known config values with default interval durations.

classes.name: ActivityCheckConfig.ActivityCheckConfigValue
classes.description: An enumeration implementing KnownConfigValue that defines specific configuration keys and their default durations for activity checks.

methods.name: getInactiveInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration that indicates how long an entity remains inactive before being considered inactive.

methods.name: getDeletedInterval
methods.description: Returns the duration that indicates how long a deleted entity remains in memory.
